prompt.text:
Reference image 1 shows the chosen design of SQUALL STEED (SS-05). Redraw the referenced subject as the sheet described below. Keep the exact design, silhouette, proportions, colour palette, materials, top-left lighting, outline weight and rendering style of the reference in every cell; only the pose or state changes from cell to cell, and the layout follows the grid described: Retro 16-bit video game sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shooter, a regular grid of twelve equal cells in three rows of four with even gutters, read left to right and top to bottom, every cell showing the same set of SQUALL STEED (SS-05) boss parts taken from the established design — the caged thunder heart behind the chest doors, the crown snout and the tail coil, facing left, at the same scale and position, on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. The frames in order: each row one part in four frames of its idle, charging, firing and damaged states, following the established boss exactly. Follow the established design exactly; only the pose or state changes between cells. Crisp pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black navy outline at the sprite's native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading ramps lit from the top-left, identical silhouette and palette in every cell, no anti-aliasing, no scenery, no stars, no cast shadow, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no numbers, no cell borders. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
 Exactly twelve cells: three rows and four columns, never four rows. Every cell shows one detached part alone, never the whole seahorse: the top row the glowing thunder heart between its two pairs of chest doors, the middle row the head with its cannon snout, yellow eye and spiked crown, the bottom row the curled blue-and-steel tail coil. No lines, borders or frames between the cells; everything around the sprites is one flat green.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, watermark, blurry, green tint on the subject, green spill
